_comment: EpicKor Instagram/Facebook performance record. Source: Meta Business Suite > 콘텐츠 > 게시됨, account epickorsnippets (asset_id 1187482087784752), read via CDP-attached Chrome. Metric column order in that table: 도달(reach) / 조회수(views) / 조회계정 / 팔로우 / 반응 / 좋아요 / 댓글 / 공유 / 저장 / 링크클릭 / 시청시간 / 평균재생 / 3초이상조회 / 인스트림수익. '--' means Meta reported no value for that format.
capture_note: First capture is a single snapshot, NOT the required 1h/24h/7d series — these posts went out 1-4 days before anyone measured them. Treat the numbers as 'days-after' readings, not as a clean 24h/7d benchmark. Start the proper 1h/24h/7d cadence with Reels 311/312/313 (publishing 07-26/27/28).

reels.flag: avg watch 5s on a 41s Reel = ~12% average completion, and 0 saves / 0 shares. This is the single clearest performance signal in the account right now: the hook is not holding past the first beat. Compare against 311/312/313 once they land before drawing conclusions from one data point.

cardnews.topic: Tteokbokki: six styles, one rice cake
Seoul with kids: what parents get wrong

observations: Reach across the three carousels (350 / 203 / 320) against 15,000 followers is roughly 1.4-2.3% — the account is still cold after the long posting pause, which is consistent with the Instagram-revival plan's premise.
Follows attributed to all three carousels: 0. Reach is happening; conversion to follow is not.
Saves are 2 / 1 / 2 and comments are 0 across the board. Save-worthy framing is the stated goal of the card-news format, so this is the metric to move.
Tteokbokki (311) outperformed both other carousels on every engagement metric — food/bunsik is the strongest-performing topic lane so far in this small sample.
Do not over-read any of this: n=4 posts, single snapshot, account recently reactivated.
